number: 第二百四十八条の四の二十七
heading_en: Sensitivities, etc. of Equity Delta and Vega Risk Factors
summary_ja: 株式のデルタ・リスク・ファクターは参照銘柄のスポット価格の相対変化、ベガ・リスク・ファクターはボラティリティの相対変化とし、リスク・ウェイトを定める。
summary_en: Equity delta risk factors are relative changes in spot prices and vega risk factors are relative changes in volatilities of the reference names in a bucket; risk weights are set by bucket.
paragraphs: The delta risk factor relating to equities shall be the relative change in the spot prices of all reference names in the bucket.

The "relative change in the spot prices of reference names" in the preceding paragraph means the value obtained by dividing the change in the value of CVA or of a CVA hedging instrument when the spot prices of all reference names in the bucket are changed simultaneously by 1% relative to their present values by 0.01.
The risk weight RW_{k} of the risk factor provided in paragraph (1) shall be as set out in the following table, according to the bucket number of the reference name. {{T:p296t1}}
The vega risk factor relating to equities shall be the relative change in the volatilities of all reference names in the bucket.

The "relative change in the volatilities of reference names" in the preceding paragraph means the value obtained by dividing the change in the value of CVA or of a CVA hedging instrument when all volatilities relating to all reference names in the bucket are changed simultaneously by 1% in relative terms relative to their present values by 0.01.

The risk weight RW_{k} of the risk factor provided in paragraph (4) shall be 78% for bucket numbers 1 through 8 and 12 in the table in paragraph (1) of the preceding Article, and 100% for bucket numbers 9 through 11 and 13.
